title: andropogon neesii var. dactyloides
intro: Andropogon neesii var. dactyloides, commonly known as 'Sugandhi Grass', is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to aid in the management of diabetes and its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sugandhi Grass include its use as an anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
